reviewer.modelVersion: not exposed by runtime; inherited parent model

observedBehavior: Receive address and QR remain unchanged through pending, repeated, completed and rejected copies.
Receive button label remains stable and role=status announces feedback separately.

Obsolete promise completions and timers cannot overwrite newer feedback or rerendered wallet labels.

Pending/repeated receive copies and shared-label scenarios exercise actual faulty behavior. Three receive-generation cases were added afterward.

browser.reviewerAction: Reviewed final browser harness diff and complete report; visually inspected final 320px failure and 1280px success screenshots. Failure text and address are readable at 320px. Some success screenshot crops omit the status row; success is established by DOM and clipboard assertions.
